Docs.summary: Provides a way for an object to be validated asynchronously.

remarks.para: Provide a synchronous implementation of when it can evaluate the applicable rules, returning validation errors for rules that reject the object. If an applicable, required rule cannot be evaluated synchronously, throw with a message directing callers to an asynchronous validation entry point.

Returning no validation errors without evaluating a rule is appropriate only when the rule does not apply, or when the synchronous pass is explicitly advisory and a separate, required asynchronous validation step governs acceptance. An empty result sequence does not indicate pending validation or arrange a later asynchronous invocation.
Do not implement by blocking on asynchronous work or asynchronously enumerated results.
